verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing pages explicitly claim 'Get answers, instantly—with citations' and 'Bring everything into one system of record,' indicating a Q&A-with-citations AI feature over workspace content, but the evidence pack lacks first-party product documentation detailing how this works, its coverage/accuracy, or independent hands-on validation. missing for 10: detailed product docs on Notion AI Q&A citation mechanics, independent/community confirmation of citation accuracy, and coverage limits across workspace content types.
